title: Meetily community workflow catalog manifest
description: Metadata for one community-built automation. A forward-compatible subset of the future wf/ execution manifest. Does not host or run code; it catalogs a workflow that runs standalone against the shipping Meetily Agent API.

id.description: Unique slug; must equal the containing folder name.

trigger.description: A live frozen trigger id, or manual/scheduled for non-event automations. transcript-ready is intentionally not accepted (dormant, no producer yet).

scopes.description: Scopes the workflow's key needs. read is implied for all; list what it actually uses.

source_url.description: Where the workflow's code lives (the contributor's own repo). Code is never hosted in this repo.

ref.description: Optional tag or commit to pin for reproducibility.

entry.description: Path to the entry file within source_url.

run.description: How to run it standalone, e.g. 'python run.py'.
